inlines.v: TANG, noun [Gr. rancor; rancid.] 1. A strong taste; particularly, a taste of something extraneous to the thing itself; as, wine or cider has a tang of the cask. 2. Relish; taste. [Not elegant.] 3. Something that leaves a sting or pain behind. She had a tongue with a tang 4. Sound; tone. [Not in use.] TANG, verb intransitive To ring with. [Not in use.] [This may be allied to ding, dong.]
